title: Panda Paws
description: Adds Panda Paws to the game, use them to climb, move and take care of your enemies!
body:
A very small mod, with good utility for Pandas!

 

Panda Paws, add an item called, well.. Panda Paws!

Allowing you to do a couple of unique things like... Climb, Walk on Powdered Snow! and even use them to defend yourself.

Try equipping one in off hand, and one in your main hand for a boost in utility!
